data.description:
## Knowledge Needed
- Read: scripts/ml_data_collector.py (data collection)
- Read: .git-ml/ structure (commits/, sessions/, etc.)
- Understand: CommitContext and DiffHunk data classes

## Implementation
1. Read existing commit data from .git-ml/commits/
2. Use cached diffs instead of re-extracting from git
3. Leverage CI pass/fail data from .git-ml/
4. Incorporate session data for workflow patterns

## Guardrails
- DO: Use existing data when available (faster)
- DO: Fall back to git commands when data missing
- DO: Handle missing/corrupt .git-ml/ gracefully
- DO NOT: Require .git-ml/ to exist (must work on fresh repos)
- DO NOT: Duplicate data extraction logic
- EXPLORE: Whether to update .git-ml/ during training
- EXPLORE: Caching trained model state in .git-ml/

## Success Criteria
- Training uses cached data when available
- Falls back gracefully when cache missing
- CI results enhance commit weights
- No data extraction duplication
data.title: Integrate with existing ML data collection (.git-ml/)
